notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK witness for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §§12.13.5 and 12.13.5.2. The C++ scenario uses the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs; its adapter supplies a ws:// RTI Address, runs a transparent TCP frame observer, and verifies List Federation Executions completes. Both callback-model runs observed binary data frames and no text frames in either direction; a separate text-frame negative control received close status 1003. This is Umbra-under-test evidence, not independent-provider interoperability, TLS/WSS, extension negotiation, or provider-wide conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::connect using an RtiConfiguration RTI Address with the ws:// scheme, followed by List Federation Executions and its report callback; adapter observes binary WebSocket data frames and verifies text-frame rejection
